plugins.name: ifixai
plugins.description: Independent auditing for AI agents, open source. Claude discovers your setup, confirms the cost, and audits your agent against the one question other tools skip: is it doing the job it's supposed to do, given your business rules and org structure? Test any model (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, …) graded by self, one independent judge, or a cross-vendor panel; each provider is billed to its own account via a key in your settings, never the command line. Results render as an interactive artifact (with a static-report fallback).
